observed_without_new_tuning.primary_endpoint: No v1.1.0 arm improved the 60.0% all-tracked exact-agreement rate.
observed_without_new_tuning.M: multiomics_evidence improved from 72.9% to 93.2%, but current_report_layer_use fell from 93.2% to 84.7%.
observed_without_new_tuning.D: The singleton design anchor improved independent-role design_families agreement from 88.3% to 95.0%, but causal_basis did not improve.

rationale.S_hypothesis: Closing the aging boundary and deriving layer-use from a stated output table will retain M's multi-omics gain without transferring ambiguity.
rationale.C_hypothesis: Mutually exclusive positive/negative causal-basis tables plus operational anchor definitions will reduce basis and family disagreement together.

selection_rule: Maximize all-tracked-fields exact agreement on development.
Reject an arm if decision-driving agreement or route agreement is lower than A0.
Break ties by decision-driving agreement, then fewer retry failures, then the smaller prompt change.
Freeze the selected arm before opening the same v1.1.0 sealed holdout.
Do not tune on sealed-holdout results.
interpretation_constraint: This cycle tunes reproducibility on development and does not estimate model-to-expert validity.
